messages:
michelle: Heads up — during the compliance review I found missing audit events for billing and runtime workflows. Need quick sync to scope impact and owners.

samir: Can you list the specific endpoints/events that are missing?

michelle: Short list so far: /v1/charge (billing API), billing webhooks (incoming), runtime job restart/eviction, token rotation events, and KMS key-change operations.

michelle: Also noticed schema fields inconsistent across services — many events lack actor.id and resource.id, some use user_id vs principal_id, and outcome (success/failure) is sometimes omitted. request_id propagation is spotty. :grimacing:

david: That matters for customer evidence (charge disputes) and internal forensics. We should treat billing + token rotation + KMS changes as high priority.

anna: I can take API Gateway mapping for /v1/charge and webhooks. I'll standardize to `actor.id`, `resource.type`, `resource.id`, `outcome`, `request_id`, `timestamp` and add an example event for acceptance tests.

michelle: example we should validate against (quick):

```
{
  "event_type": "billing.charge.create",
  "timestamp": "2025-11-12T15:23:01Z",
  "actor": {"id": "user:U123", "type": "user"},
  "resource": {"type": "invoice", "id": "inv_456"},
  "outcome": "success",
  "request_id": "req_89ab",
  "metadata": {"amount": 1200, "currency": "USD"}
}
```

samir: For auth/runtime: I’ll own token rotation + authz decision events. Need to confirm we log key identifiers (KMS key version) on key-change ops. Also we should ensure token rotation includes old_key_id/new_key_id in metadata.

ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-1427: "Service audit evidence gaps — billing/auth/runtime" and linked to compliance doc https://docs.internal/redwood/sec/SEC-1427 :white_check_mark:

david: Proposed plan: 1) formalize schema v1.3 with required canonical fields, 2) implement lightweight adapters in each service to emit canonical fields (2-3 dev days each), 3) enable export/filtered view for customer evidence on billing routes, 4) run a canary with one enterprise customer for billing disputes.

michelle: Agree. Also KMS integration note: for Private deployments we need guidance for customers on how HSM/KMS events map into our schema — add to doc.

anna: I'll add acceptance tests: search by request_id, verify presence of actor.id & outcome, and sample export that contains only customer-facing evidence fields.

samir: Owners by service: anna -> gateway/webhooks, david -> billing pipelines & export, michelle -> runtime job events & KMS mapping, samir -> auth/token rotation. Timebox spike for KMS HSM logs: 2d.

michelle: Labeling: tag backlog items with `audit-evidence` and `compliance-p0` for billing-related work. We'll also add a checklist for schema migration in the ticket.

david: I'll slot billing work into next sprint and coordinate with GTM for customer comms. :thumbsup:

michelle: Thanks everyone — I'll update SEC-1427 with the schema draft and sample event list. Follow-up sync tomorrow 10:30 PST. :eyes:

anna: ack, will start PR template for adapters and tests.

samir: ack — will draft token rotation event spec and KMS fields today.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: `Compliance sync — auditlog gaps` tomorrow 10:30 PST (created by michelle).
